result.markdown: --- title: >- [cmark_version()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Return the version string of the vendored cmark-gfm library. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/multimark/blob/feat-markdown-to-plaintext/src/multimark/_cmark.py#L849-L869){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python cmark_version() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Reports the version of the bundled cmark-gfm C library that multimark was compiled against. This is useful for debugging or confirming which release of the underlying parser is in use. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A version string in the format `"X.Y.Z.gfm.N"` (e.g., `"0.29.0.gfm.13"`). ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#3f3b1eed .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from multimark import cmark_version cmark_version() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` '0.29.0.gfm.13' ``` ::: :::
